basic_info.description: Classic Sunset Home with Stunning Ocean Views - Perched in the desirable Sunset-Parkside neighborhood, this classic tunnel entrance home offers unobstructed ocean views and timeless San Francisco charm. Filled with natural light throughout, the main level features a bright living room with refinished parquet floors, a cozy fireplace, and a separate dining room perfect for gatherings. The refreshed kitchen shines with new countertops, flooring, and appliances, complemented by a skylight above. A skylit hallway leads to two generously sized bedrooms, one with a walk-in closet, both capturing spectacular ocean vistas. The bathroom includes both a tub and a separate shower.    Additional upgrades include newly refinished hardwood floors, new double-pane windows, and fresh interior and exterior paint. The lower level offers a spacious bonus room, ideal for a guest bedroom, office, or flex space. The large garage provides abundant storage, laundry area, and potential for future expansion. The cozy backyard is the perfect spot to enjoy evening sunsets over the Pacific. Conveniently located near Sunset Boulevard, local shops, public transportation, and freeway access. This home combines comfort, convenience, and breathtaking views in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods.
